summary: The audit found critical accepted-envelope and authorization bypasses at the immutable audited HEAD.
blocking_findings: ID: P2-RB-001. Severity: critical. Title: Callers can fabricate accepted envelopes and cross-company evidence. Evidence: packages/backend/src/modules/finance-operations/index.ts:8 exports normalization publicly. packages/backend/src/modules/finance-operations/controlled-imports.ts:188-205 compares two caller-supplied receipts without the attestor or private reader. An adversarial probe accepted private-evidence://other-company/finance/fabricated under company-a and returned ready. Impact: A caller can import fabricated or cross-company evidence. Recommendation: Bind normalization to the accepted attestor and private-reader result.

ID: P2-RB-002. Severity: critical. Title: Malformed authorization results and caller-built plans fail open. Evidence: packages/backend/src/modules/finance-operations/controlled-imports.ts:462-472 validates no authorization result and rejects only deny. An adversarial probe returned accepted and called the repository for decision malformed. Impact: A faulty port or caller-built plan can bypass authorization. Recommendation: Strictly parse decisions and capability-bound plans. Fail closed.

ID: P2-RB-003. Severity: high. Title: The runtime source grammar accepts unreviewed fields and kinds. Evidence: packages/backend/src/modules/finance-operations/controlled-imports.ts:18-30 omits reviewed sensitive and policy keys. Probes accepted bankAccountNumber, expenseCategory, thaiTaxInvoice, vat, withholdingRate, and unknown-document-kind. Impact: Raw-document lookalikes and unreviewed policy data can enter the boundary. Recommendation: Use strict nested Zod unions and reject unknown keys.

ID: P2-RB-004. Severity: medium. Title: Variant ambiguity uses the wrong identity field. Evidence: test-strategy-phase2.md:206 requires ambiguityGroupId collision handling. packages/backend/src/modules/finance-operations/controlled-imports.ts:345-349 compares logicalDocumentId and ignores ambiguityGroupId. Impact: The boundary can accept ambiguous evidence or reject distinct evidence. Recommendation: Validate and compare ambiguityGroupId.

ID: P2-RB-005. Severity: high. Title: The public pilot function returns accepted without trusted pilot behavior. Evidence: packages/backend/src/modules/finance-operations/controlled-imports.ts:510-527 checks two strings and always returns accepted. measure/tracks/company_finance_operations_20260810/plan.md:35 keeps the real pilot blocked. Impact: A contract stub can grant normal pilot authority. Recommendation: Remove accepted authority until the trusted pilot flow exists.
nonblocking_findings: ID: P2-RB-006. Severity: low. Title: The amount parser has no length limit. Evidence: packages/backend/src/modules/finance-operations/controlled-imports.ts:167-179 converts an unbounded string with BigInt. Impact: A large accepted value can consume excessive CPU and memory before denial. Recommendation: Set a decimal length limit.

ID: P2-RB-007. Severity: low. Title: Authorization failures lack failed audit outcomes. Evidence: packages/backend/src/modules/finance-operations/controlled-imports.ts:465-471 runs authorization outside the failure audit block. Impact: An authorization service failure has no command failure audit event. Recommendation: Append a sanitized failed event.
